dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...If that isn't an option, then I can't really think of anything else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Would you like a cup of tea? I can go make one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're the guest. Shouldn't I be the one making tea for you?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: It's no trouble. For me, making tea is a truly enjoyable activity.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I make tea for everyone whenever Lyney receives a guest.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Selecting the best tea leaves, testing the water temperature, and observing the steam as it rises from the water's surface... I very much enjoy the whole process. Only with absolute concentration can you brew the perfect cup of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who would've thought the process is so complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Also, no one will drag me into a conversation when I'm busy making tea.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: And once the tea is ready, as long as you sit there holding the cup and maintain the appearance of sipping your tea in peace, nobody will try to talk to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So the point is still to zone out, then.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Hehe, I was kidding. Was that surprising? I can crack jokes every now and then, too. I just rarely see the need.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: But I really do enjoy brewing and drinking tea. I'm able to taste even the most subtle differences in flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Considering all the places you've visited, you must have tried many different flavors during your journey.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: You want to try one of my brews next time you're free? I'd love to hear your thoughts on it.
